rules.statement: A document with roles and short-form permissions decides exactly as one with its RoleExpansion.effective form written out.
properties: runtime:RoleExpansionPropertyTest#ROL-1 a document with roles decides as its effective form written out

rules.statement: Compilation, the grant analysis, the reference index and the diff read the expanded document.
A role of an app document that names an undefined permission does not compile; one of a tenant document is a REFERENCES finding, and on the data plane it fails closed.
`*` is written only in an app document, and a catalog that grows shows as new derived bindings.
A permission with both an action and a hand-written policy does not compile.
A short-form permission of a group that is not spaced applies only in the default space.
Role ids are validated, a derived binding id that collides does not compile, and `role:` is reserved to derived bindings.
A document whose roles derive more bindings than the limit does not compile.
PutRole is analyzed per permission, what cannot be proved contained needs an approval, and adding a permission needs cosec:grant.
A permission a tenant's role lists cannot be removed from its app.
A role applies only in its own app, and a role that names a space only in that space.
